style_prompt: Editorial-quality flowchart diagram, hand-drawn line work on warm off-white paper background (#F7F4ED). Two-tone palette of deep Alberta navy (#1A3A6E) for primary nodes and rust orange (#C2491A) for accents and arrows. Boxes have subtle shadows; labels in clean sans-serif; arrows are slightly curved with arrowheads. Architectural, calm, technical but human. Wide editorial aspect. No photo realism, no people, no logos, no watermarks. All text labels in English.
image_prompt: A clean editorial before-and-after diagram of one government application, split left to right with a large rust arrow across the middle. LEFT HALF, labelled "SISTEMA HEREDADO": a boxy 1990s beige desktop computer showing a plain text terminal screen, with a paper form and a sealed mailing envelope beside it. RIGHT HALF, labelled "SISTEMA MODERNO": the same application reborn as a clean modern web portal on a slim laptop, with a small PDF document and an upward upload arrow beside it for direct document submission. Background across the top: a quiet rural scene with a small farmhouse and a propane tank, set far from a thin natural gas pipeline running along the horizon. Include ONLY these exact text labels, each spelled exactly and large enough to be perfectly legible: "SISTEMA HEREDADO", "SISTEMA MODERNO", and the application title "Solicitud de Subsidio de Calefacción para Zonas Remotas" shown once on each side. Do NOT add any other words, field labels, menu items, or body text anywhere; leave all form fields and screen lines as blank ruled lines or empty boxes so there is no risk of misspelled or garbled text. Muted Alberta cream base with deep navy line work and small rust accents, archival print quality, no logos. All text labels in es. Match the composition of the source image exactly; only the text labels change.
